scripts.format: bun run format:js && bun run format:go
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n backend,web,mobile -c blue,green,magenta "bun run dev:backend" "bun run dev:web" "bun run dev:mobile"
scripts.postinstall: concurrently -n mobile,web -c magenta,green "cd apps/mobile && npm install" "cd apps/web && bun install"
